newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-DAZZLE FLOP UPSETS TRAINER STOUTE.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-DAZZLE FLOP UPSETS TRAINER STOUTE.

text.p: Dazzle, the hot 9-4 on favourite, could only finish fourth to French raider Pas de Reponse in Tuesday's Cheveley Park Stakes, a group one test for next season's classic fillies.
Dazzle's trainer Michael Stoute was clearly upset at the tactics adopted by jockey Kieren Fallon, who next year teams up with Henry Cecil in one of racing's top jobs.
Stoute said: "Perhaps Dazzle wasn't at her best but she was left stranded at the back of the field. I would have wanted her to have been closer than that."
With 300 metres left, she was fully six lengths adrift of Freddie Head, riding Pas de Reponse for his sister Criquette.
Pas de Reponse (7-1) won by a length from Moonlight Paradise, the mount of Frankie Dettori, still basking in the glow of Saturday's seven-timer at Ascot.
Third place, another length away, went to Ocean Ridge, ridden by John Reid, with Dazzle a further half a length behind.
It was Criquette Head's third winner from just three runners at Newmarket this season.

She was also upholding a proud family record in the Cheveley Park Stakes. Her father Alec won the six-furlong (1.2 km) race several times and she herself has also captured the event with subsequent 1,000 Guineas winners Ma Biche and Ravinella.
After Tuesday's victory Pas de Reponse was quoted at 7-1 for next year's Guineas with Dazzle at 8-1. Neither is guaranteed to stay the 1.6 km Guineas trip.
